name: FA_MC_LEASE_EXPENSE_DETAIL
description: This table contains lease expense details for each asset associated to lease at distribution level.

columns.name: LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the accounting ledger.

columns.name: LEASE_EXPENSE_DETAIL_ID
columns.description: Lease expense amount identification number per period for each distribution.

columns.name: LEASE_EXPENSE_SUMMARY_ID
columns.description: Lease expense summary identification number.

columns.name: BOOK_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Name of the asset book in which the lease is recorded.

columns.name: ASSET_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the asset number.

columns.name: PERIOD_COUNTER
columns.description: Depreciation period identifier.

columns.name: DISTRIBUTION_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the Asset distribution .

columns.name: LEASE_SOURCE_CODE
columns.description: Source from where the lease record was created. Possible values are B(BOOKS) and L(LEASE).

columns.name: LEASE_INTEREST_AMOUNT
columns.description: Interest amount included in the periodic lease payment.

columns.name: YTD_LEASE_INTEREST_AMOUNT
columns.description: Year-to-date lease interest expense of the asset.

columns.name: LEASE_INTEREST_ADJ_AMOUNT
columns.description: Lease interest expense adjustment amount for the period.

columns.name: LEASE_PAYMENT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Periodic lease payment amount that the lessee pays to the lessor.

columns.name: LEASE_LIABILITY_BALANCE
columns.description: Running lease liability balance of the asset.

columns.name: LEASE_EXPENSE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Lease expense amount for the asset for the period.

columns.name: YTD_LEASE_EXPENSE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Year-to-date lease expense of the asset.

columns.name: LEASE_EXPENSE_ADJ_AMOUNT
columns.description: Lease expense adjustment amount for the period.

columns.name: PERIODIC_DEPRN_RESERVE
columns.description: Accumulated depreciation for the asset for the period.

columns.name: DEPRN_RESERVE
columns.description: Accumulated depreciation balance of the asset.

columns.name: EVENT_ID
columns.description: Transaction event identifier that is associated with this row for accounting purposes.

columns.name: LEASE_RUN_ID
columns.description: Lease program submission identifier.
